integrity: A complete combinatorial and total-positivity proof is supplied together with deterministic independent exact-rational checks. Scientific priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite categories with strictly positive iid sampling probabilities and a common integer quota of at least two. No assertion for heterogeneous quotas, dependent draws or infinite categories. The 1982 quota paper was available only in abstract, leaving a specific historical-priority risk.
title: Strict likelihood-ratio ordering of first quota winners in unequal-probability sampling
